infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: ADAPT reads motion from the phone on the floor beside you to sense how your movement is going, so the workout can adapt.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ADAPT listens for a short list of workout words like “easier” so you can change the workout without picking anything up.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech is recognised on this device to match a short list of workout words. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
